# Axiom Proof

> Agentic DPDPA compliance platform for Indian mid-market enterprises. AI agents discover your personal data, assess your gaps, and — after you approve — execute the fix. Every action is sealed into a verifiable, hash-chained audit trail.

## What we do
- Automated DPDPA + DPDP Rules 2025 gap assessment against 43 versioned controls
- AI agent discovery of personal data across systems (Phase 2 live connectors; Phase 1 interview-driven)
- Typed remediation plans with dry-run diffs, blast-radius caps, and generated rollback plans
- Approval-gated execution: no mutating action runs without a signed, scope-bound human approval token, validated per action
- Append-only, hash-chained audit ledger for every action — agent or human
- Continuous evidence vault (S3 Object Lock Compliance mode, India region)
- Board, auditor, and DPB-ready reports

## Who we serve
- Indian mid-market enterprises: 200 to 1,000 employees, ₹50 to 500 crore revenue
- Companies facing real DPDPA penalty exposure (up to ₹250 crore per contravention) without a privacy team and without the budget for enterprise compliance suites
- CA / CS / law / DPO firms looking for a white-label delivery partner

## The non-negotiable safety rules
1. No mutating agent action executes without recorded human approval
2. Every executable action needs a completed dry-run with a readable diff
3. Every action carries a generated, validated rollback plan
4. Every action — read or write, agent or human — is written to the hash-chained ledger
5. The planning agent holds no write credentials (separation of duties)
6. Blast-radius caps enforced pre-flight and in-flight, with a global kill switch
